collection.title: Mazda E2200 1985 to 2001 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mazda E2200 1985 to 2001 model which requires a 15" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 15" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
